messages:
sophia: noticed a spike of Pending inference pods in ap-south1 with tiny vGPU requests (0.25/0.5). nodes show leftover fractional capacity that won't fit anything.

ben: any k8s events or scheduler warnings?

sophia: quick kube top:```
NAME                       READY   STATUS    AGE     NODE
infer-small-x              0/1     Pending   2h      <none>
infer-small-y              0/1     Pending   1h30m   <none>
model-train-big-2          1/1     Running   8h      node-ap2-07
```
Nodes report 0.25 unusable on many racks.

vik: that smells like reservation accounting mismatch. We saw a bug where PreBind webhook failures left the allocator marking fractions as allocated but never completing the bind. Any webhook latency/error spikes?

ops-bot: Alert: ap-south1 vGPU unusable-fragmentation > 60% for 45m. Namespaces impacted: platform-ml, experiments.

ben: pull scheduler logs around the first Pending.

sophia: logs show:```
I0405 09:18:21.111 scheduler/allocator.go:158] "reserve" pod=infer-small-x node=node-ap2-07 amount=0.25 txn=rid-194
I0405 09:18:21.412 scheduler/webhook.go:77] "prebind hook timeout" txn=rid-194 err=timeout(250ms)
I0405 09:18:21.413 scheduler/allocator.go:203] "reserve cleaned?" node=node-ap2-07 txn=rid-194 status=stale
I0405 09:18:21.414 scheduler/allocator.go:220] "orphans detected" node=node-ap2-07 orphan=0.25
```
Looks like the reserve wasn't rolled back consistently.

vik: we should implement two fixes: short-term reclaim loop to sweep orphaned fractions and force reconciliation; mid-term change to prebind handling so reserve gets rolled back on webhook failures (or increase prebind timeout if webhook is stable).

ben: short-term non-disruptive: run a controller that calls the scheduler API to list node reservations and releases orphans older than X seconds. We can run in ap-south1 first.

sophia: I'll spin up a canary reclaim controller with a 30s orphan threshold (only affects nodes with <0.5 free). Will monitor for reschedule churn.

vik: long-term: propose scheduler patch: ensure Reserve() and Bind() are idempotent and add a transaction TTL so stale reservations auto-expire after N seconds. Also add metrics on reserve/rollback success rate.

ben: also consider a nightly binpack compaction that cordons a small subset of nodes and migrates best-effort pods to consolidate fractional capacity. Run at 03:30 cluster local time. Lower risk than mass drains during business hours and saves cost.

ops-bot: Note: reclaim controller will trigger cluster-autoscaler signals if it causes many pods to reschedule. Watch scale-up events.

vik: action items: 1) sophia deploy reclaim-canary to ap-south1 (ETA 15m). 2) ben open a PR to adjust prebind rollback TTL + add telemetry. 3) sched-watch add alert for reserve-orphan-rate > 5/min.

ben: ping me on the canary results, and we should draft a postmortem if reclaim affects any running jobs.

sophia: deploying canary now. will report back with fragmentation delta in 20m. thanks. :wave:
